request: AI Core check two actual backend state after apparently ready but terminal exit one

bounded_host_request.command: docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}' | grep '^ai-' || true; for c in ai-coder ai-qwen3; do docker inspect "$c" --format '{{.Name}} running={{.State.Running}} exit={{.State.ExitCode}} oom={{.State.OOMKilled}}'; done; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/ai.slice/ai-core.slice/memory.current 2>/dev/null || true; ss -lnt | grep -E ':(18080|18082|18084|18181|18184) ' || true
